bukti: The dataset collected for this research consists of 180 images with a size of 640x640 and a camera resolution of 12 Mega Pixel.

bukti: Each image in the dataset is annotated with a class of oil palm fruit bunch, raw, half, or ripe, using bounding boxes to define the class of the image.
All images were collected at Thaksin Palm Company under real industrial conditions.
The fine-tuned variant, YOLOv8x19, with 19 frozen blocks, achieved even higher Precision, Recall, and F1-Score at 0.97, and mAP@0.50, mAP@0.50–0.95 at 0.99, 0.77 respectively.
